tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i gsang ba'i las mkhan lnga la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog srid zhi dbang rgyal bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal gur gyi mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir ma hā kā la'i gsang ba'i las mkhan lnga'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ 'dir dang po bya tshul ni/ rab chu shing / seng ldeng / stag pa la sogs pa/ ma 'byor na shol po/ lcang ma/ shug pa la sogs pa'i mdung shing 'dom gang las mi thung ba mtshal lam/ btsag la sogs dug khrag dang sbyar bas kha dog dmar po bsgyur bar bya/ gsom dben shing yin pas mi rung / glang ma 'byung po'i bla shing yin pas mi rung / thug lcags mi rta khyi gsum bsad pa'i lcags la dbyibs rtse gsum mam/ rtse mo gcig pa ral gri'i rnam pa can smad lcags sbubs su yod pa/ rtse mo me ris la sogs pas spras shing rno dbal dang ldan par bya/༈ dug khrag la bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags btab pas ngar blud/ thug rnga rab 'brong rnga/ g.yag 'bras bu can gyi rnga ma/ ma 'byor na rnga ma nag po gang yang rung ba rnams shing gi 'khor lo'i rgya gram la bstan nas mdzes par btags/ las mgon 'khor bcas kyi gsung gi rten gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo 'jam lugs man ngag nas 'byung ba'i bri rdzas kyis bris la bzang tshon gyis sku dang zhal dbye sogs shin tu zhib cha byas pa'i 'khor lo gnyis ru mtshon gyi nang bzhugs la zhal sbyor gyi nges pa ma bshad pas bltab lugs ni/ lte ba ma chag par g.yon thog mar bltab/ de nas g.yas bltab/ de nas zhabs yar bltab/ sku stod nas mar bltab la/ mgrin pa nas yar bltab pas lte ba'i yig mgo dang zhal gnyis gyen la langs stabs su yong bar bshad kyang blo yi rnam pa la de mi bde na sku rten dang 'dra bar phyag g.yas ngos nas sgril la dbu zhabs ma nor bar bya/ gang ltar na'ang tshon skud sna lnga dang dar gyis gtum la la chas bsdams la lcags sbugs sam/

snyug sbugs gang rung du bcug pa dang 'bod rbad bsad gsum gyi sngags kyi mthar las mgon/ gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam sring 'khor dang bcas pa ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ sgrub pa po bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ 'gal rkyen sel/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams la ltas dang cho 'phrul drag po mngon sum du phob la myur du tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces pa shog bu la dug khrag gis bris pa ci mang rnams mdung shing gi rtse mo la dkris pa dar sna dang tshon skud kyis mi 'chugs par bsdams pa lcags sbugs su bcug la gzer gyis bsdams/ sku rten ro ras sam shog bu la las mgon lnga yi sku gri khrag gis so sor bris/ gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis 'jam lugs bya/ phyag g.yas nas rim bzhin 'phred la dril/ dar skud sna lngas dkris/ dar snas bcings la/ gri lcags sam/ snyug rgod kyi sbubs su bcug la phyi nas la chas byugs/ srog 'khor kyang de ltar bcings la la ril bya/ drag po'i shing tsher ma can la byang bu mtho gang pa bcos pa'i ngos la gong bzhin 'bod rbad bsad gsum spel tshig dang bcas pa dug khrag dang snag tshas bris pa la chus byugs/ thugs kyi rten du me long gi ngos su gri khrag dang sindhu ras hūm̐ yig bris pa lnga'am gcig yon tan gyi rten du/ ras sam dar gyi khug ma'i nang du 'bru sna tshogs/ sman sna tshogs/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ 'phrin las kyi rten du/ gong gi shing byang dang / khrab byang mig dgu pa/ bse byang / stag ras/ gzig ras/ 'gron bu'i len tshar/ dril bu g.yer kha/ mi mgo mi lag mi snying la sogs pa/ dar ras sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa/ 'phan tshar ci mang / de dag thams cad gong gi dang ma'i zhol chen gyi khrod du gdags/

de lta bu'i thug chen de/ mgon po 'khor bcas kyi rten dang gtor ma legs par bshams pa'i mdun du mañdzi chen po la brten pa'am/ phyogs bzhir brgyang thag byas la bzhugs/ de yi mdun du stegs bu'i khar bse phor gtsang mar chang rgod kyi phud gtsang ma la rin chen brdar ru'i phye ma'am/ rin chen lnga dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i khar/ 'khar ba la sogs pa'i snod du khrag chang sha sna mar bdud rtsi ril bu rnams phye phud la btab pa'i las mgon gyi gta' gtor zur brgyad pa la gsang rten mda' dar nag pos brgyan pa/ rgyan dang mtheb skyu sogs man ngag bzhin bcos pa bshams/ gsol kha'i chas kyi sha dum bu/ khrag chang / mchod pa rnam pa lnga la sogs pa legs par bshams/ rnal 'byor pa dpon slob rnams kyis yi dam gyi bdag bskyed gtor bsngo bskang gso rnams gzhung ltar byas/ ru mtshon la dmigs te zhi ba/ zhi drag phyed ma/ drag po rnams kyis sbyang ba khrus gsol dang bcas pa bya/ rten dang gtor ma rnams nang mchod kyis sbyangs la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gtor ma mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i ri bo zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgyar bcas la ci mang brjod/ ru mtshon a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ bskyed chog la gur mgon gyi chos skor rnams las pho rkyang mo rkyang 'khor rkyang sbags sgrub sogs gang byas kyang chog par gsung mod/ 'on kyang brgyud pa'i man ngag las/ las mgon rnams kyi rjes gnang skabs su yang sbags sgrub gsungs shing / 'khor rkyang sogs rkyang sgrub cung zad rtsub par bshad pas/ des na sbag sgrub du bskyed tshul ni/

lcam dral lha gsum bris sku sogs yod na der bskyed/ med na mdun gyi nam mkhar bskyed la lcam dral gyi thugs ka nas gnod sbyin yab yum spro ba man chad kyis ru mtshon bskyed chog byas la/ bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba zhes pa'i bar dang / de rnams kyi mdun du dur khrod kyi sa gzhi raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su bdud rta bra nag rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs dang ldan pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng du ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ mun pa'i mdog can zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bdud kyi khram shing rtse mo gsum pa'i mgul na/ dar nag gi ba dan dang / mi mgo'i lan tshar 'phyang ba kun nas brten pa/ g.yon pas mi snying rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa dug sbrul nag po'i zhags pa dang bcas pa zhal du 'jibs shing phyir sprug pa/ lcags kyi ral pa nag po drag du sprug cing gsig pa/ lcags kyi mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs nas ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ sku stod dar nag gi ber zhol gsol zhing / sku smad gcer bu la dug sbrul mang po lang long du dkris pa/ skad cig nyid la stong gsum yud kyis bskor zhing / dgra bgegs kyi srog dbugs sdud pa'i drag shul can/ de'i g.yon phyogs su ma bdud spu gri'i mched mo srin mo khros pa'i gzugs can/ gcer mo rgyan med rkang pa gsum bgrad stabs kyis gnas pa/ phyag gnyis kyis me dpung 'bar ba 'dzin cing / kha nas me 'bar ba gdong phyir phyogs pa yab yum gnyis ka'ang me rlung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam/ de nas gtso 'khor rnams kyis gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug gi tshig dmigs bsal la rang bzhin gyi gnas dang / lho phyogs ri rab kyi khong gseng nas las mgon pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa zhes sbyar/ dam bzhag la ni sa pā ri wā ra zhes khongs su bran bdud kyang 'thus par sems/

gtor bsngo mchod 'bul/ 'phrin bcol rnams rgyun bzhin la/ las mgon lnga'i gtor sngags kyi rjes su/ oṃ ma hā kā la yakṣa murtsa kro dha ya ma ra dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma ri ma sha murtsa ya bhyoḥsarba bighnān sha trun mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas gtor ma 'bul/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs nag po chen po lcam dral gyis gtso mdzad pa'i/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ phyogs bcu'i gnas rnams nas byon/ mdun gyi nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang thams cad khyab par bzhugs par bsams la/ dar nag 'phyar/ rol mo rnams kyi sgra sgrog gu gul dang sha chen tshil chen gyi dud pa sbyar/ dam tshig gi rdo rje dar nag gi g.yab dar dang bcas pa/ mi rkang dang shugs pa'i sgras 'bod/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin brtan po dang ldan pas rnga brdung zhing dbyangs dang bcas te/ hūm̐/ las gyi mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dad pa dang / /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs bdag gi phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ bhyoḥ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu tra bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /gsang ba'i khro mo rnam pa bzhi/ /'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa gsum/ /las mkhan mon pa bdun dang ni/ /dgra la thun 'bebs mon pa drug /yang sprul mon pa bye ba'i tshogs/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi'i 'khor tshogs rnams/ /gnas 'dir myur bar gshegs su gsol/ /sprin ltar 'thibs pas 'dir gshegs shig /glog ltar 'khyug pas 'dir gshegs shig /'brug ltar grags pas 'dir gshegs shig /thog ltar 'gril bas 'dir gshegs shig /hūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/

/ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /hūm̐/ dam can mkha' 'gro 'dul ba'i gnas/ /byin rlabs yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde chen rol pa'i gzhal yas khang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /hūm̐/ sbyar ba'i spos dang g.yab pa'i dar/ /rnga chen sgra dang dung chen gling / /rnal 'byor drag po'i ngar skad kyis/ /spyan 'dren ma thogs myur du byon/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod sbyin rgya mtshos mchod/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur cig /ces yid ma yengs par spyan drangs la/ 'bod pa gnyis kyi mthar/ e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing drag rol yun ring du bya/ oṃ karma nā tha pañtsa sa pa ri wā ra grihṇe daṃ/ a nas/ shapta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis phyi mchod dang gang gi sngags kyi mjug 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ ru mtshon la rdo rje gzungs thag dang / dar thag btags pa'i sne nas rnal 'byor pa gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin gyis bzung / dpon slob rnams mgrin gcig tu 'bod rbad bsad gsum brgya rtsa'am/ nyer gcig tsam re 'ur 'don bya/ de'i tshe rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku la phog pas/ thugs dam gyi brgyud bskul thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i pho nya las nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus mdun bskyed rnams la thim pas gzi brjid nus pa lta bas mi bzod pa khams gsum thams cad 'dar phri le yod par bsam/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gcig gam/ gnyis gsum tsam gyis gzungs thag sogs nas bzung / 'og gi bskul dpyad mi byed par/ 'bod rbad bsad gsum rgyun ma chad par gzung gzhan rnams kyis gsol kha bya ste/

de yang sngar gyi stegs bu'i khar gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su sha dmar po dum bu dgu/ chang phud gtsang ma bzhag g.yon du phyi mar dang / khrag chang bzhag mdun du las kyi rdo rje zhig gis lcags snod gtsang ma'i nang du g.yas nas sha re/ g.yon nas phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug gsol kha tshar re la de 'dra ba lan gsum gtor chen la bstabs cing / g.yas g.yon nas khrag chang kyang thig re blug rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i bye brag kun thogs nas/ mdun gyi gtor rdzas dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen pos stong gsum khyab par bsam/ de rnams las mgon 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal dmar gnam tsam gdangs pa'i nang du sib kyis bstabs pas hab thob tu bzhes nas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes nas/ bdag gi ci bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub par bsams la dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ mgon po'i mtshan gsol gsad pa'i las mkhan lnga/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra ba/ /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal can/ /bdud 'dul dpal bo las mgon 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan gsang ba'i las mgon 'khor bcas la/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa dam par 'bul/ /dges pa'i sems kyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs dam 'phrin las nyer dgongs la/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams zhi ba dang / /'dod don mthun pa'i rkyen rnams 'grub pa dang / /thub pa'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'dur dbyangs bya zhing / hūm̐/ dpal ldan las mkhan nag po/ /rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ /lha srung yongs kyi ded dpon/ /dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ /rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing /

/rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ /bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra ba/ /dus gsum nad kyi sman pa/ /bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ /gsod byed gshin rje pu tra/ /bdud chen mon bu bha ṭa/ /sha za sring mo ral gcig /dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ /mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ /gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi bdud pho khyed rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hī khā hī/ zhes brjod cing 'bod pa gnyis kyi mthar gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha dang po bstabs/ yang bshams la/ gzhan yang gsang ba'i khro mo rnam bzhi/ bran bdud gshin rje yab yum/ sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa/ las mkhan mon pa rnam bdun/ dgra la thun bebs mon drug yang sprul mon pa bye ba/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpung nyi khri chig stong / lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / dregs pa pho rgyud/ mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ mdun gyi shugs 'dren/ g.yas g.yon gyi ru 'dren/ rgyab kyi rjes myul/ mkha' lding / bya nag khyi nag lce spyang sngon po/ mi nag po 'o dod can/ sprul pa khro bo'i tshogs/ bdud nag po gshin rje'i tshogs/ gdong can gyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam pa 'bul zhing gsol lo/ /mchod do/ /rol chen dang las mgon rnams kyi 'bod rbad bsad gsum bzlas shing / gsol kha gnyis pa btabs/ yang bshams la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te/ khyed rnams kyis dgyes shing mos pa'i thabs kyis bzhes la rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa gdon bgegs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu bskyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrubs/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/

gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog cig gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyags chad kyi ma dang blo lhag gi pha mdzod cig rgyab kyi slog pa dang mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud cig ral na tshems shig stor na 'tshol la brjed na bskul cig mgo gang gis yar la bstod la/ dkyus gang gis mar la srings shig gzhan yang legs pa brgya dang sprod/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol/ bsam pa yid bzhin du sgrubs/ re ba rgya mtsho lta bur skongs shig mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams bzlog cig gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan la brtan par bzhugs te/ dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thams cad bshig cig dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyor cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig gzhan yang spo la dar 'phyor la/ khrom du dung bus shig gtam ngan rgyun chod la snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan nam mkha' la 'phyor la/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang byang chub sgrub pa'i mgon grogs mdzod cig skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang brten dang brling mdzod cig bdag cag gis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig 'bod pa gnyis gtor sngags sbyar ba dang / a kā ro bzlas zhing / rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gsum pa bstabs/ slar yang de 'dra ba tshang ma tshar gnyis te yongs dril tshar gsum rdzogs pa dang / de dag gi lhag ma lus pa rnams kyang bstabs/ de nas mnga' gsol dpangs bstod rgyas par bya ba ni/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas sngags 'chang rgya gar bas mdzad pa'i pu tra'i mnga' gsol bya/ de nas gzung thag rnams dkrol/ khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas/ mdun gyi srung ma rnams las pho nya las mkhan stong gsum khyab par 'phros nas/

zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub cing / khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ sha khrag rus pa sogs rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drangs par bsam la/ bskul ni/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i las mgon gyi bskang ba las bzhi lhun grub las/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal ldan mgon po'i bka' 'khor nas/ /dam can gnod sbyin yab yum bskyod/ /me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /mi zan pu tra ming sring bskyod/ /phyogs bzhi'i dmag gi sna 'dren pa/ /stobs chen ru 'dren sde bzhi bskyod/ /snang srid yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /dregs byed lha srin sde brgyad bskyod/ /khrag zhag khol ma'i rba klong nas/ /srog bdud mon nag gshin rje bskyod/ /bstan dgra 'joms byed grong khyer nas/ /sprul pa'i ltas ngan cho 'phrul bskyod/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs lhang se lhang / bhyo yig 'bod sgra di ri ri/ /shugs pa'i glu len kyu ru ru/ /rgyob sod nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /phyogs kun mun nag thibs se thib/ /mtshon cha'i me stag skar ltar 'khrugs/ /khrag nad bu yug char ltar 'bab/ /'jigs rung rlung nag 'tshubs se 'tshub/ /bshan pa'i gri skor ling se ling / /ma mo'i khrag zor mda' ltar 'phen/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul zings se zing / /dgra ming bla 'bod lhang se lhang / /kun kyang khro gtum ri rab tsam/ /mthong ba tsam gyis dgra snying 'byin/ /las mdzad mon pa pho mo'i tshogs/ /khyod la mthu dang rtsal yod na/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i yul khams su/ /khrag nad dal yams gzer chen phob/ /ltas ngan cho 'phrul pho nya khyes/ /glo bur ye 'phrog sna tshogs thongs/ /dgra snying dmar po spar gyis thob/ /dgra khrag dron mo hub kyis drongs/ /zhing chen g.yang gzhi gos su gyon/ /thod rus rgyu rlon rgyan du gyis/ /lo dang zla bar ma bzhag par/ /zhag dang za ma'i dus nyid la/

/dgra bgegs dpung dang bcas pa rnams/ /til 'bru tsam yang med par mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdag dang bdag cag gi /'khor du gtogs pa'i skyes dgu rnams/ /khyod kyis bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / /las bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /bran bdud la bye brag tu bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ ri rab ri yi rtsa ba nas/ /las mgon chen po sku bskyod cig /nam gyi gung dang nyin gung la/ /dam nyams dgra bo gsod cing byon/ /'khor ni bdud mgon bdun brgya dang / /gza' bdud bdun brgya pho nyar bcas/ /dam las 'das pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mthun pa'i yo byad ji snyed rnams/ /tshogs bcas 'bul lo bstan pa'i las/ /bdag cag bsrung phyir 'dir bsten no/ /nag po dran phyir 'dir bsten no/ /bka' las ma 'da' 'dir bzhugs shig /dgos 'dod sgrub phyir 'dir bzhugs shig /ji srid ma gshegs bar dag tu/ /gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /gang bcol las rnams bsgrub tu gsol/ /ces brjod/ de nas las mgon 'khor bcas zhu ba las byung ba'i ru mtshon gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ 'phyar ba dang phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i ru mtshon de nyid mdun gyi las mgon 'khor bcas la rten du 'bul ba'i tshig ltar brjod/ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs bcas dgongs/ /bka' nyan gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /khams gsum srog gi gshed ma ni/ /las mkhan mon bu pu tra dang / /bha ṭa gser gyi spu gri ma/ /gsang ba'i yum bzhi bran bdud dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi mon pa gsum/ /las mkhan mon pa bdun dang ni/ /dgra la thun 'debs mon pa drug /yang sprul mon pa bye ba'i tshogs/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi'i 'khor tshogs dang /

/dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud dang / /sde brgyad bshan pa bcas pa kun/ /bdag la brtser dgongs rten la bzhugs/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i ro thang 'dir/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil pa'i rba klong ljongs/ /sde brgyad bshan pa bcas pa kun/ /dam nyams baṃ chen bsgyel ba'i khrir/ /brtan par gtsug pa'i ru mtshon mdung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i srog shing rtser/ /rno dbal gri lcags mdung so la/ /dug khrag sngags rgod ngar dang ldan/ /lhab lhab 'bar ba'i me 'od can/ /g.yag rgod rog po'i rnga g.yab kyi/ /zhol chen sprin nag lta bur gtibs/ /dar nag ba dan 'phan rtse gsum/ /rlung gis bskyod pa'i 'phur lding g.yo/ /sku rten ro ras tsakli/ /gsung rten srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags/ /thugs rten gsal ba'i me long dang / /yon tan rten du nyer lnga'i rdzas/ /'phrin las rten du dar ras 'phan/ /bse lcags shing byang dam nyams kyi/ /mgo lag 'gron bu'i lan tshar can/ /dril bu g.yer kha'i sil sil 'khrol/ /phun tshogs rgyud las legs grub cing / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /thug chen 'bar ba drag po'i rten/ /rten mchog ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bzhugs pa'i pho brang chen por 'dzugs/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /dngos grub char rgyun dus 'dir phob/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i gnas dang rten du 'dzugs/ /padmo'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar/ /'bral med 'dus nas las kun sgrubs/ /dregs byed dmag dpung ru mtshon mchog /g.yul las rgyas ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bstan dang rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /sdang byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod kyi/ /srog shing tshe yi rten du 'dzugs/ /mi nor chos dang legs tshogs kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing brtan par mdzod/ /de ltar ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i rten du 'dzugs/

/da bcol zhu ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bsam don 'grub pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /snang srid dregs byed gzhi bdag rnams/ /ru mtshon 'di la brtan bzhugs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bstan pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe dang / /byang chub bar gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ mdun gyi bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams dang / snang srid kyi dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad mtsho la char pa babs pa bzhin du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan de nyid la thim par bsam zhing mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug khyed rnams ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung / dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod/ bstan pa dang rnal 'byor la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdugs pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ shis brjod kyi tshig skabs su gang babs brjod/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ gtor sgrub kyi lhan thabs las 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /de ltar srung ma rnams la ru mtshon btsugs pa'i phan yon ni/ ru mtshon gyi rten de nyid gang du yod sar/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams mkha' la sprin 'du ba'am mtsho la ngang pa 'du ba'am/ sha rul la sbrang ma 'du ba ltar/ gnas de nyid du rtag par bzhugs nas/ yul phyogs dge mtshan dang ldan pa dang / sgrub po rnams kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod don thams cad bsgrub par 'gyur bas/ tshul 'di la brtson par bya'o/ /zhes rdo rje nag po chen po'i gsang ba'i las mkhan lnga la brten pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog srid zhi dbang rgyal zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgya mtshan dpal bzang pos tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan srung rnams la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog las/

las mgon kho na la bya tshul zur du phyung nas mnga' gsol dang bskul sogs tshad thub kyi yig cha nas kha bskangs te mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bsod nams 'od zer gyis bgyis so// ༈ /swasti/ las mgon lnga'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog la nyer mkho'i zin bris ni/ rgyas 'bring gnyis las/ gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs rgyun gyi thugs dam dang sbrel dgos kyang / 'dir ru mtshon 'dzugs chog rkyang pa'i dbang du byas na/ gnas yo byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i bdag bskyed lam dus rgyas 'bring gang rung / bum bskyed kho bos sbyar ba'i zhal gyi dam tshig bskang gso'i 'go bzhin/ sbyang ba rgyun bzhin dang / bden brdar rab gnas bzhin la/ tshig bsgyur ni/ las kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i nang rten ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i sogs gzhan 'dra/ khyad par gyi spyan 'dren gyi 'gor/ bcom dung dang dad ring gi byin 'bebs/ spyan 'dren shlau ka gnyis la dad ring gi dbyangs rol sbyar la/ shlau ka gnyis pa'i 'gor/ hūm̐ u bhyoḥl sogs sbyar/ de phyin chad 'dur ma/ hūm̐ yod mtshams rnams gyi 'go dang / dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur la/ tshigs rol la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rjes ma 'di'i mthar chems brdung gsum brdeg len can rol mo 'bebs bcas/ phyi nang gi mchod pa la so so'i phyag rgya/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal nas 'dar phril ler yod par gyur zhes pa'i bar brjod na legs/ gsol kha'i dbyangs rol sogs lag len rnams kho bos sbyar ba'i mgon mdos gtong tshul gyi phyag deb bzhin/ gsol kha gsum pa rdzogs pa'i mthar nyis brdeg len can du bsgyur la pu tra'i mnga' gsol shlau ka dang por srin thung ma'i dbyangs rol rdzogs nas rgyun bzhin dgu brdung / drag bskul la rnga phyir brdung / mnga' gsol dang 'di gnyis char rnga 'phar ma/ drag bskul rdzogs pa'i tshig rol gyi mthar/

rol mo rnam sras bstod kyi 'go bzhin/ bran bskul shlau ka gcig la gur drag mtshams gcod kyi dbyangs rol/ de phyin rnga 'phar ma/ rdzogs mtshams tshig rol chems brdung / drag dung gsum brdeg len can las mgon nas gyur gyi bar/ bcom dung bcom rol gsum brdeg len can lugs bsangs 'go bzhin/ 'bul tshig shlau ka gcig la dus gsum bde gshegs ma'i dbyangs rol/ de phyin rnga 'phar ma/ rdzogs mtshams tshig rol chems brdung / mjug gur drag gi mchod rol bzhin/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug sogs la rab gnas kyi brtan bzhugs bzhin las drag rol dang drag dung gsum pa rdzogs nas gsum brdeg len can/ bkra shis dril gsil ma ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar rol mo bya zhing / mjug chog ni rgyun bzhin no// //zhes pa'ang kun blos smras// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 kun dga' blo gros/ gur gyi mgon po'i gsang ba'i las mkhan lnga la ru mtshon 'dzugs chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 13
